prompt: Create a Python 3.12 command-line todo application. Users can add tasks, list tasks, mark a task as completed and delete a task. Store the tasks in memory.

intentions.text: I can add a new task to the todo list.
intentions.observable: The task is listed in the todo list after execution.

intentions.text: I can view all current tasks in the todo list.
intentions.observable: A list of all tasks is displayed on stdout.

intentions.text: I can mark an existing task as completed.
intentions.requires: a task index (position in the list)
intentions.observable: The specified task is marked as completed and shown as such in the list.

intentions.text: I can delete an existing task from the todo list.
intentions.requires: a task index (position in the list)
intentions.observable: The specified task is removed from the list.
